rows.grounds: introduces additional elements in the same manner as previously stated
powers of the enclosures of the śrīcakra; object of hearing implied from context
connects the listed elements of the procedure
meditation on those enclosure-powers; tat refers back to varaṇaśaktīḥ
worship of those enclosure-powers; tat refers back to varaṇaśaktīḥ

items.question: Which additional components of the ritual procedure must be learned to obtain the desired fruit?
premises: The procedure of the worship grants the desired fruit.
The enclosure-powers form part of that ritual procedure.
Meditation on and worship of those powers are included in that procedure.
items.inference: Learning the enclosure-powers together with their meditation and worship completes knowledge of the fruitful ritual procedure.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tat in taddhyānaṃ and tatprapūjanam is inferred from the immediately preceding varaṇaśaktīḥ.
items.plain_english: Likewise, learn of the enclosure-powers, and of their meditation and their worship.
